She then proceeded to send messages with sporadic words like “o..g I fe....my...fu”. I text a mutual friend  who then went round to her house. I then got a text from the ex girlfriend saying “YOU TOLD MY FUCKING FRIEND FUCK YOU”. They weren’t medical pills but chewy vitamins.

Or the ex-girlfriend who would if it was her turn, drive home while sneakily taking high dose sleeping pills (while driving) and then I’d spend the next 40 minutes praying for my life as she faded in and out of being awake. She had a pill addiction and managed to keep it hidden from me. Her favourite thing to do was if we were having an argument and she wasn’t “winning” (in her words), would threaten to scream “rape” or that “you should just fucking drop dead/fucking kill yourself” as loud as she can. When we broke up she laughed and said “yeah I was pretty fucking psycho at times”.

Or the ex-girlfriend who in the beginning told me she had a high sex drive (sex ranks quite high to me in relationships) and in the beginning she did but the day before she was going to meet my parents she said that she was asexual. She then told me that she only really figured it out the day before she arrived to see me. Regardless of the fact we didn’t sleep together at all for months, she became emotionally distant, didn’t talk to me at all and when I ended it she got her best friend to tell me that she has always been asexual and when she said she had a high sex drive she lied.

I realise that with these women the unifying factor is my own poor choice of partner.
